methodology: Expand9 exhaustive identity growth. Prefer Melda/Voxengo/PSP/Softube/PA product-list deltas (0 net after dedup) + Native Instruments Sounds/Expansions collection as soundset. New FOSS hubs Carla + yabridge. D16 sound expansions + bundles. u-he BazilleCM/bundles/eurorack Wiretap+CEN2RION. TAL legacy KVR. AudioThing Kontakt soundsets. Kazrog Avalon EQ bundle. Polyverse bundles. Jack skipped. Dedup by manufacturer norm + id. No invented versions.
